description: DBC source registry - tracks modules and features that modify DBC databases

databases.scratch_dbc: Temp workspace during imports/rebuilds (created/dropped as needed)
databases.dbc: Live database - Spell Editor and dbc.py work here

notes.priority: Lower numbers = applied first. Features (100+) override modules (10-50).
notes.enabled: Set to false to exclude a source from rebuild without deleting it.
notes.tables: List of DBC tables this source modifies (for conflict detection).
